decisions.reason: As a recent launch close to our core air-cooling business, already publicly presented and consistent with our efficiency-focused trajectory, we would be inclined to give it more time and treat any weak early uptake as temporary.

This condenser sits squarely within our established engineering capabilities and announced product direction, so the sunk development effort and public commitment make withdrawal within a year unlikely.

Although it appears close to another condenser offer and could later face portfolio rationalization, its recent launch, strategic fit, and the tendency to justify prior investment still favor keeping it for now.

The liner for corroded tubes strongly supports our lifecycle-service and upgrade business, making it highly complementary to the installed base and therefore something management would be reluctant to abandon quickly.

A customized industrial air cooler matches our traditional strength in tailored integrated solutions, so we would likely continue backing it and attribute any initial sales variability to project cycles rather than product failure.

These repair inserts fit directly into our service, maintenance, and reliability proposition, and because they build on existing customer relationships and capabilities we would be especially prone to persist with them.
